caption: The video captures an indoor swimming pool from an elevated side view, where Omega-branded starting blocks line the water's edge. Swimmers wait set on the blocks facing the lanes, with red, blue, and yellow ropes stretching down the turquoise water. Spectators sit on tiered bleachers behind the blocks, and a rescue ring and clocks hang on the far wall. For most of the excerpt the swimmers hold their set positions with slight postural shifts and small movements among the onlookers. The water shows gentle ripples. Near the end the swimmers lean forward and launch off the blocks, bodies arcing toward the surface; the nearer competitors follow a beat later, still mid-dive as the clip closes.
